system.description: Difficulty equals (7 - Resources sacrificed). Prayer to Siakal. For the rest of the scene: all Valor rolls succeed automatically, character ignores wound penalties, immune to non-magical fear. However, character drops to Compassion 1 and is compelled not to show the slightest mercy to anyone (cannot be resisted — was asked for). Each use weakens Intimacies based on love or kindness.
